mentions.h: FROM 'The Belgravian' 25 years ago and 40 years ago
mentions.note: won the first National Youths Race, Dartmouth Park, West Bromwich, 10 March 1945

Belgrave's outstanding Junior of 1946; on cover of Athletics, November 1946; won Middlesex Junior cross-country, Southern Junior cross-country, Middlesex Junior mile, Southern and AAA Junior miles (record) 1946
won Youths 880yds, British Games, Whit Monday 1946
9th Middlesex cross country 1950 (as Cadogan AC); won Middlesex 1 mile
